sentences.text: Slackia isoflavoniconvertens is a human intestinal bacterium that converts the main soybean isoflavones daidzein and genistein to equol and 5-hydroxy-equol.
Researchers identified a cluster of eight daidzein-induced genes, three of which encode a daidzein reductase, a dihydrodaidzein reductase and a tetrahydrodaidzein reductase.
Gut bacteria play a key role in the metabolism of dietary isoflavones, influencing the availability and bioactivation of these polyphenols in the intestine.
A study of school-age children that measured urinary equol and sequenced 223 faecal samples reported Slackia isoflavoniconvertens significantly associated with equol production.
